Why this site exists

The official locator shows you dots on a map; the fee schedule lives on another site; appointment rules on a third. We merged the State Department's complete facility database with verified 2026 fees and plain-English process guides — and nothing else. We are not the government, we don't book appointments, and we don't sell expediting. Every data point links back to its official source.

Passport Office Finder

Every passport acceptance facility in the U.S. — post offices, libraries, courts and clerk offices — with phone numbers, hours and services, from official State Department data. Plus plain-English guides to fees, timelines and expedited service.

This is a private, independent website for informational purposes only. It is not affiliated with, operated by, or endorsed by the U.S. Department of State, USPS, or any government agency. Facility data comes from the State Department's public locator; hours, fees and rules can change — the binding source is always travel.state.gov and the facility itself. We do not schedule appointments or process applications.
